fields.title: 📖 Ṭāwūs: Not the Kufr that takes one out of the Millah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ṭāwūs:**

> ***“Concerning al-Māʾidah 5:44, Ṭāwūs explained that what may be meant by it is a Kufr that does not take one out of the Millah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This explanation is a firm foundation of the Salaf: the term Kufr is not mechanically always understood as Kufr Akbar.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Qurṭubī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44.
